tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bshams dang thig rtsa bzhugs so// 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i bshom zur du bkod par/ sa chog ma byas pa'i sa yin na de'i chas nged rang gi dkyil chog tu bkod pa bzhin/ sta gon/ gang du dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas su chag chag dang rkyang nul la sogs pa legs par byas gnam sa bar gsum gyi rgyan rnams bkram/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gzhir dri bzang dang bdud rtsi ril bu la sogs pa byug thig chen brgyad dam/ las thig yongs su rdzogs par btab ste/ cha chen bzhi pa phan chad kyai rdor bzhin la/ cha chen gsum pa gru bzhi btab pas lha snam/ de la thug par gcig dang de'i nang du cha phran phyed dang gnyis spangs par zlum skor nyis hreg ni gdung zlum/ tshangs thig las g.yas g.yon du cha phran gsum dang / de nas phyed dang gnyis yangs par thig brgyad bsnol mar btab pa gdung bzhis mig mang ris kyi thig go /lha gnas rnams su dbus su dri bzang po'i thig le gru bzhi/ 'khor rnams kyi gnas su zlum po bya/ de dag gi steng du 'bras sam nas la sogs pa'i 'bru dri bzang gis sbags pa'i me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ gtso bo'i steng ngam dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du/ mañdzi'i steng du sa lha'i tshom bu'ang bkod/ 'dod snam la shar du gtso bo dang / gti mug gshin rje gshed tsartsi ka tho ba gshin rje gshed rnams kyi sgos mchod spos me zan/ de bzhin shar lhor lho'i lha gnyis dang lho nub kyi sgos mchod/ nub tu nub lha gnyis dang nub byang gi sgos mchod/ byang du byang lha gnyis dang byang shar gyi sgos mchod/ rdo rwa me ris kyi phyi'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin/ shar du khrag gi mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs gsil/ lhor dbang lnga'i me tog lho nub tu spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du drag po'i bshos bu/ nang gi byang shar du sa lha'i gtor ma dang mchod pa sum tshan kyang bshams/

dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du 'das gtor/ shar lhor 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du las kyi gshin rje dang / sgos kyi chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma sogs skabs dang sbyar la bshams/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga'am sbreng tshar du bshams/ yang na gtor ma mchod pa bcas pa 'di dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab phyogs sogs gang bder bsham pa'i phyag len kyang mdzad/ sngon 'gro'i zlum gtor/ phyi rol gtor ma 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin/ rdor dril nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ bum sman so lnga chu gtsang dang sbyar bas bkang ba'i bum pa gnyis kha dog gang rung gi mgul 'ching prog lnga'am bdun ku sha sogs kyis kha rgyan ma 'byor na zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang / zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i tsakli/ dung chos rdor gzungs/ gos zung / zhu 'bul dgos na maṇḍal nas bcas/ tshogs pa mang na rnga rol dung rkang gling / rdul tshon lnga so so'i mdang 'don dang / thig skud sna lnga/ so so'i gru gu/ de dkri ba'i rdo rje slob ma/ dbang bskur dgos na mtshams sbyor nas byung ba'i yo byad rnams/ tshon gyis 'bri ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su thod rwa sgo gcig pa'i nang khrag mtsho rlung dkyil mtshon pa'i ljang nag dang / de'i steng ro mgo med lag med mjing pa shar du bstan te pad nyi'i steng du phyag mtshan 'bri na rdo rje rtse dgu nag po dang / mang na tshom nag gdung bzhi dang gdung zlum nag po la rdo rje ser po dgu'i nang khrag mtsho/ shar du mi mgo'i steng pad zla la 'khor lo/ dkar po'i tshom dkar/ lho lag gnyis steng pad nyi la nor bu ser po'am tshom ser/ nub tu rgyu ma pad nyi la padma dmar ram tshom dmar/ byang du rkang pa gnyis dang padma'i steng du rlung mtshon pa'i ljang khu la ral gri ljang khu'i tshom ljang / shar lhor thod pa pad zla la 'khor tshom dkar po gang rung / lho nub tu thod tshal pad zla la rdor sngon tshon sngon gang rung /

nub byang du ro ras pad zla la pad dmar ram tshom dmar/ byang shar du mi ro gsal shing rtser bskyon pad zla la ral gri ljang khu'am tshom ljang / de'i phyi khyams shar sgo'i g.yas nas gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing / g.yon nas chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig lcags kyu/ lho sgo'i g.yas nas dgra satwa mda' kha ṭwāṃ/ g.yon nas dbyug tho 'khor lo rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgo'i g.yas nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ ḍā ma ru phub/ g.yon nas gzhu dril bu jo dar/ byang sgo'i g.yas nas sdig mdzub 'phan rkang gsum glang lpags/ g.yon nas tho ba mdung me thab/ sgo bzhi'i gdan gyi 'og na thod dbyug padma ral gri rnams yod kyang 'bri mi thub/ sgo bzhir pad nyi la gdan gyi 'og tu bshad pa'i phyag mtshan de rnams sam yang na shar sgor tshom sngon/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lha snam de'i grwa bzhir ro langs mdog dmar ser nag po gang rung mgo gsum lag gsum rkang gsum yod pa gar stabs can phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ljang dmar ser sngo/ 'dod snam nas bzung rdo rwa me ris kyi bar rta babs snam bu bzhi pa yod pa'i dkyil 'khor spyi 'gre/ shing ris mi gcig pa du ma yod kyang so so'i dbyibs 'bri mi thub/ shar gyi shing sdong gi rtsa bar tshom bu ser po/ lhor sngo/ nub dkar/ byang ser/ shar lho dmar/ lho nub nag nub byang sngo skya/ byang shar dkar/ yal ga'i gseb tu tshom bu shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub nag byang ser/ shar lho dmar/ lho nub sngo/ nub byang ljang / byang shar sngo skya/ sprin shar ser/ lho sngo/ nub dkar/ byang ser/ shar lho dmar/ lho nub sngo/ nub byang nag byang shar dkar/ sprin de rnams kyi chu brgyad kyi dkyil du tshom bu/ shar ser/ lho dkar/ nub dmar/ byang nag shar lhor ser skya/ lho nub dkar/ nub byang ser/ byang shar ljang / grub chen brgyad mtshon pa'i tshom bu kha dog gang rung /

me chu mchod rten sogs spyi 'gre/ de nas spyi mchod sgos mchod rnams gang rung sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor du zlum po khor yug gam ras bris ltar na gru bzhir bshams/ de'i mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du mda' dam/ bcu la brten pa'i tshon skud kyi drwa ris dang / grangs de snyed kyi ral gri me long dar tshon la sogs pas kyang bskor bar bshad pas spros pa la dga' na bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas mda' drwa phyed tshul la rtsibs bcu ma dang brgyad ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub gnyis su lhag ma re dang bcas pa'i mda' 'jug bstan 'jim pa sogs las grub pa bcu cha snyoms par bzhag la/ de dag la mda' zhe 'gro ring thung med par btsugs pa la phyogs skyong bcu'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i dar dang me long re btags la/ tshon skud sna lnga'i gru gu'i sne byang shar gyi mda' rtsar dkris la/ de shar gyi mda' g.yas pa'i rtse mor khyer g.yon pa'i rtsa ba dang / shar lho'i rtse dang / lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho nub kyi rtse dang / nub g.yas ma'i rtsa ba dang / g.yon ma'i rtse dang / nub byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang gi rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtsa bar phyin la yar dkri/ shar gyi mda' g.yas kyi rtsa ba dang / g.yon ma'i rtse dang / shar lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho'i rtse dang / lho nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub g.yas ma'i rtse dang / g.yon ma'i rtsa ba dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang shar gyi rtse dang / shar lho'i rtse dang / nub g.yas kyi rtse dang / byang gi rtse dang / shar g.yon ma'i rtse dang / lho nub kyi rtse dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / shar g.yas ma'i rtse dang / lho'i rtse dang / nub g.yon ma'i rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtse rnams su phyin pa'i skud lhag mda' de'i rtsa bar drangs nas bzhag par steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i rnam pa 'byung /

rtsibs brgyad byed na mda' brgyad btsugs la/ shar gyi mda' la dar dkar po dang dmar skya btags/ nub kyi mda' la dkar po dang ser skya btags/ gzhan rnams la gong bzhin btags/ dang por dbang ldan gyi mda'i rtsa ba la tshon skud kyi sne mo btags la/ de nas shar gyi mda'i rtse mor khyer nas dkris/ de bzhin du shar lho'i mda'i rtsa ba dang / lho'i rtse mo dang / lho nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang gi rtse mo dang / de ka nas byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / shar gyi rtsa ba dang / shar lho'i rtse mo dang / lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub byang gi rtse mo dang / byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / de nas shar gyi rtse mo/ de nas mda' gnyis gnyis bor te/ lho nub kyi rtse mo la dkris/ de bzhin du byang gi rtse mo dang / shar lho'i rtse mo dang / nub kyi rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtse dang / lho'i rtse dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / shar gyi rtse dang / de nas re re bzhin du/ shar/ shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang / byang shar gyi rtse mo rnams la dkris re byas nas 'khor mor bskor ba'i lhag ma byang shar gyi mda'i rtsa bar drangs nas bzhag pas/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i rnam par 'byung ngo / /phyi rol gtor ma la/ lcog tse la sogs pa'i steng du/ chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du pad ma 'dab ma bcu pa la phyogs skyong so so'i mtshan ma bkod pa'am/ dri bzang gi chus gru gsum du byugs pa'i/ dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bcu bkod pa gang rung gi steng du/ mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar lcags sder sogs kyi snod du zan gras drug cu rtsa bzhi lag len ltar rtsig pa'am/ bsdu na gtor ma zlum po gcig la mtheb skyu drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba rgyan dang bcas pa bshams/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar du bshams/

gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ slob ma dbang bskur byed na de'i chas mtshams sbyor nas 'byung ba bzhin no// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bshams dang thig rtsa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
